questions.question: Why build projects without a framework first?
questions.answer: Frameworks hide layout and cascade behavior. Building raw CSS forces you to understand box sizing, grid/flex, specificity, and responsive units, which makes framework debugging much easier.

questions.question: What should a responsive landing page demonstrate?
questions.answer: A mobile-first layout, a grid/flex header, fluid typography with clamp(), a readable hero, and accessible buttons/focus states. It should reflow at 320px without horizontal scroll.

questions.question: How do you make pricing cards equal height with a bottom CTA?
questions.answer: Make the card a flex column, let content grow, and give the CTA margin-top:auto. In a grid, align-items:stretch makes cards equal height by default.

questions.question: Why use dialog for a modal project?
questions.answer: dialog + showModal() provides a native top layer, backdrop, focus trapping, Escape handling, and background inertness, avoiding fragile manual implementations.

questions.question: What makes a theme easy to maintain?
questions.answer: Semantic design tokens declared at :root, overridden by [data-theme] and prefers-color-scheme. Components consume tokens only, so theme changes never touch component CSS.

questions.question: Create the dashboard shell with named grid areas.
Why does a modal animation ignore prefers-reduced-motion?
questions.answer: The animation is declared without a reduced-motion override. Add a media query that sets animation:none (or a very short duration) so users who request reduced motion do not get the entrance animation.

questions.question: Why can a design system page drift from production?
questions.answer: If tokens/components are copied rather than imported from the same source, documentation and production diverge. Generate the page from the actual CSS/tokens or keep a single shared stylesheet.
